title: Success
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.46 Numbered Discourses 5.46
  • 5. Muṇḍarājavagga 5. With King Muṇḍa

Sampadāsutta Success

“Pañcimā, bhikkhave, sampadā. “Mendicants, there are five accomplishments. Katamā pañca? What five? Saddhāsampadā, sīlasampadā, sutasampadā, cāgasampadā, paññāsampadā—Accomplishment in faith, ethics, learning, generosity, and wisdom. imā kho, bhikkhave, pañca sampadā”ti. These are the five accomplishments.”

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
